sloka: निजघ्नुः शैलशूलास्त्रैर्बिभिदुश्च परस्परम्।सिंहनादान् विनेदुश्च रणे वानरराक्षसाः ।। ६.६९.६० ।।
transliteration: nijaghnuḥ śailaśūlāstrairbibhiduśca parasparam।siṁhanādān vineduśca raṇe vānararākṣasāḥ ।। 6.69.60 ।।

translations.english: The Rakshasas killed by Vanaras, their shields and weapons broken, blood flowed from their limbs just as sap exudes from broken trees.
